description: This Dart file defines the TransactionsTab widget and related classes for managing and displaying financial transactions in a Flutter application. It includes UI components for listing transactions, dialogs for adding/editing transactions, and data models for form handling.

classes.name: TransactionsTab
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the main transactions tab with a list of transactions.

classes.name: _TxnFormData
classes.description: Data class for handling transaction form data, including conversion to request payloads.

classes.name: _TransactionDialog
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the dialog used for adding or editing transactions.

methods.name: _openAddDialog
methods.description: Opens the dialog for adding a new transaction.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the TransactionsTab, displaying the list of transactions.

methods.name: _TxnFormData
methods.description: Constructor for initializing form data either empty or from an existing item.

methods.name: toCreateBody
methods.description: Converts form data into a payload for creating a new transaction.

methods.name: toPatchBody
methods.description: Converts form data into a payload for updating an existing transaction.

methods.name: _TransactionDialogState
methods.description: Handles state and logic within the add/edit transaction dialog.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Validates and submits the transaction data to the provider, managing loading state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the dialog UI with form fields for transaction details.
